children: Flyte Aviation approved a 1-for-10 reverse stock split and will change its name from Catheter Precision, effective Oct 5, 2026.
Board approved name change from Catheter Precision to Flyte Aviation and a 1-for-10 reverse split effective 12:01 a.m. ET on Oct 5, 2026.
Reverse split combines every ten shares into one; no fractional shares issued—holders receive cash for fractional interests from sale by exchange agent.
Reverse split won’t change par value or authorized shares; equity awards, warrants and convertibles will be proportionately adjusted.
Common stock expected to trade on NYSE American as Flyte Aviation with ticker VJET and new CUSIP 74933X807 starting Oct 5, 2026.
